title: YourMondayMotivator: Powerful choices (or the Power of Choice)
html:
Choice. You and I live in a universe of choice. A veritable Everest high mountain of choices await when we wake up in the morning. From our first stretch to our breakfast and our mood for the day. We choose.

This makes us powerful. In the movie The Matrix the power of choice is shown vividly when Morpheus offers Neo a choice between a red pill and a blue pill. One will leave him in the make believe of the Matrix the other will bring him to reality. He chooses reality.


In my opinion there is nothing we cannot do or achieve and there are plenty of amazing examples of that occurring every day. We are lucky. In our world's we are free but are we making the most of it?

Viktor Frankl said, "Everything can be taken from a man or a woman but one thing: the last of human freedoms to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one's own way."

Are you choosing your own way?

Think about this for a minute. Actually go for a run or a walk and let the question float around in your head. Because I am sure you will find that in some areas you are making choices and others you aren't. Imagine the possibilities if everything was your choice. Evening tonight's dinner. You would get what you want.

Have an excellent week and I have a draw running on my Facebook page. When we get to 500 likes I am going to put everyone in the draw for 8 copies of the best book in the world. Check out what it is and let me know if you agree at facebook.com/mondaymotivator.

Glenn
